overview_description.description: Lex is an international oilfield technology company founded in 2016 that focuses on transforming artificial lift systems for the modern energy sector. The company designs and deploys ultra-high-speed electric submersible pump (UHS ESP) technologies engineered to increase oil well productivity, enhance operational reliability, and lower environmental impact. Leveraging aerospace-inspired engineering innovations, Lex provides customized solutions for complex onshore and offshore wells, including remote monitoring, automated production management, and rigless deployment systems. Its technology is used across operational oil fields in Europe, Central Africa, Southeast Asia, and North America. The company also emphasizes sustainability by helping operators reduce carbon emissions and energy overconsumption while improving overall production efficiency.

about_short_description.short_description: Lex Submersible Pumps designs, manufactures, and supplies artificial lift equipment.

product.name: Ultra-High-Speed ESP (UHS ESP™)
product.description: An electric submersible pump system operating at speeds up to 12,000 rpm designed for artificial lift in oil wells, optimized for harsh conditions and power savings.

product.name: Lex Universal Permanent Magnet Motors (UPMM)
product.description: Permanent magnet motors providing rotational energy for submersible pumps, with speeds from 85 to 12,000 rpm and operational capability in high-temperature environments.

product.name: ESP with Jet Pump (Jet ESP™)
product.description: A combined artificial lift system integrating electric submersible pumps with jet pumps to optimize production and enable gas re-injection in gassy wells.

identifier.value: Surface Permanent Magnet Motor for Sucker Rod Pumps (SynchroGear™)

product.name: Surface Permanent Magnet Motor for Sucker Rod Pumps (SynchroGear™)
product.description: A surface permanent magnet motor system designed to drive sucker rod pumps without V-belts, aiming to reduce power consumption and CO2 emissions.
